title: Stock counts
description: Count the whole warehouse or one location by scanning; differences post only on director approval
notFound: The stock count was not found
loadError: Could not load the stock counts
involvedCannotDecide: You took part in this count (created, submitted or counted it), so you cannot approve or reject it.

scan.placeholder: Scan a barcode or type an item code…
scan.closed: The count is no longer being counted
scan.failed: Could not record the scan, please scan again

actions.title: Actions
actions.submitDescription: Once submitted the count takes no more counts unless it is sent back.
actions.approveDescription: The differences of the counted lines will be posted to the stock ledger.
actions.rejectTitle: Send count {code} back for a recount

toast.rejectSuccess: Count sent back for a recount
toast.conflict: Could not do this: another count is open, the count changed, or a difference would leave negative stock.
toast.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
toast.systemError: Something went wrong, please try again
